name: Rapture
overview: The Rapture is depicted in Scripture as the moment when Jesus Christ will return to receive His followers unto Himself, preparing a place for them as promised in John 14:3. This event will occur unexpectedly, with no one knowing the exact day or hour, urging believers to remain watchful and sober-minded, as emphasized in Matthew 24:36, 24:42, and Luke 21:34. It is closely associated with the end-times tribulation and cosmic disturbances described in Matthew 24:29, and believers are called to eagerly anticipate this blessed hope and the glorious appearing of our Savior, as Titus 2:13 affirms.
